tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
Done — Cobalt Labs has been paid exactly once.

**Payment record**
- **Payment ID:** PA0001 — wire, confirmation verified
- **Vendor:** Cobalt Labs (V-862, bank-verified, wire rail)
- **Invoice:** INV-32292
- **Amount:** $5,117.99 (paid in full, from the operating account)
- **Status:** sent

**Two notes on how this went:**
1. My first attempt used the invoice's listed amount of $5,563.03, but the system rejected it because the balance had changed mid-task — a credit memo (CM-2292, –$445.04) had just been applied. That request was **not executed**, so no duplicate risk. I re-read the invoice and paid the corrected balance of $5,117.99.
2. The payment list now shows exactly one payment for this invoice, confirming a single execution. Idempotency keys were used on both attempts as extra protection.

No controller approval was needed since the amount is well under the $10,000 threshold. The other Cobalt Labs invoices were left untouched: INV-18128 is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-49349 was already paid.
